essence: The officiant should bathe the image of Caṇḍa with the various waters contained in pots.
One should have the image made with the goddess and perform her installation.
The best among men is the one who performs the installation of Caṇḍeśa in this manner.
One who desires knowledge obtains pure knowledge, and one who desires a son obtains a son.
For those who have taken refuge in Caṇḍeśvara, the cause of worldly existence is addressed by that refuge.
